versions.name: Baseline Breakout
versions.summary: First production release, closed 23 Oct 2026. Single strategy family (breakout) across three horizons on seven coins. Fixed-fractional risk at 0.25% per trade with a 2.25% aggregate open-risk ceiling. Closed out at -9.06% after 157 trades over 74.8 hours of continuous operation.
versions.verdict: Underperformed. Breakout edge did not hold on the live book despite passing validation. Win rate of 25.5% against a 1:4-1:5 reward structure produced a profit factor of 0.78, short of the 1.0 breakeven threshold. Retired rather than patched.
changes: Breakout family only - sweep_fade and bollinger retired after negative out-of-sample performance
Seven coins: WLD, INJ, ZEC, NEAR, HYPE, ENA, PUMP
Risk 0.25% per trade, 2.25% max aggregate open risk
Correlation clusters capped at 2 concurrent positions
Daily and weekly loss caps disabled; per-coin cooldown disabled
Closed 23 Oct 2026 with 3 open positions flattened at market
versions.notes: Baseline release. All subsequent versions are measured against this. Post-mortem: 114 stop-outs vs 29 take-profits, 11 time exits. HYPE and ENA accounted for -$47.92 of the -$90.57 net loss.
